name: Driving Clean Assistance Program: Clean Cars 4 All
description: Up to $10,000-$12,000 + $2,000 charging incentive or $7,500 mobility option for trading in an old gas car in areas without a local Clean Cars 4 All program; financing assistance currently closed
fullDescription: The Driving Clean Assistance Program (DCAP) helps income-qualified Californians trade in old gas vehicles for clean alternatives. Bay Area residents are served by the Air District's own Clean Cars for All program for scrap-and-replace, and DCAP's financing assistance pathway is currently closed.
whatTheyOffer:
- Clean Cars 4 All scrap-and-replace: up to $10,000 toward a clean vehicle ($12,000 in disadvantaged communities)
- $2,000 for a home Level 2 charger or a prepaid public charging card
- Alternative: $7,500 mobility option
- Scrap-and-replace is only for areas without their own air district Clean Cars 4 All program (Bay Area residents should apply through BAAQMD Clean Cars for All)
- Financing assistance pathway (down payment help, credit counseling, lower-rate loans) closed to new applications as of August 2026
howToGetIt:
1. Check income eligibility (household income under 300% federal poverty level)
2. MUST apply BEFORE trading in or buying a car
3. Trade-in vehicle must be 2010 or older, under 10,000 lbs, with 2+ years of operation history
4. Replacement vehicle must be $45,000 or less; used vehicles 75,000 miles or less
5. One incentive per household; not available if you already received a CARB light-duty vehicle incentive
keywords: DCAP, Clean Cars 4 All, electric vehicle, trade-in, $10000, down payment, financing, low-income
